policy: Primary research metadata approved for offline reference. These papers do not define On-chip product operating conditions.

sources.title: Formation of dispersions using flow focusing in microchannels
sources.authors: S. L. Anna, N. Bontoux, H. A. Stone
sources.approved_summary: Flow-focusing droplet size and generation regime depend on the two liquid flow rates and their ratio; monodisperse and polydisperse regimes can occur.

sources.title: Controlled encapsulation of single-cells into monodisperse picolitre drops
sources.approved_summary: Stochastic cell loading creates variability in cells per droplet; controlled cell ordering can improve single-cell encapsulation.

sources.title: Beating Poisson encapsulation statistics using close-packed ordering
sources.authors: A. R. Abate, C. H. Chen, J. J. Agresti, D. A. Weitz
sources.approved_summary: Random loading produces many empty droplets; close-packed ordering can depart from Poisson loading for suitable particles.

sources.title: Biocompatible surfactants for water-in-fluorocarbon emulsions
sources.approved_summary: Surfactant chemistry affects water-in-fluorocarbon droplet stability and biological compatibility during formation, incubation, and reinjection.

sources.title: Fluorescence-activated droplet sorting (FADS): efficient microfluidic cell sorting based on enzymatic activity
sources.approved_summary: Fluorescence-activated droplet sorting can screen encapsulated reactions; co-encapsulation and loading density can limit enrichment independently of sorter error.
